# Xing Premium Tattoo Studio - Brookefield, Bangalore

> Custom tattoo studio in AECS Layout, Brookefield, Bengaluru (on the First Floor of SV Plaza, above DMART Ready, AECS Layout, Brookefield). Lead Artist Peace (Chingri Awungshi) (15+ years) designs every tattoo from scratch — realism, portraits, Black & Grey, geometric, Indian traditional and minimalist fine-line. Sterile, single-use equipment. Free consultation.

- Address: First Floor, SV Plaza, 267, 60 Feet Road, Above DMART Ready, AECS Layout, Brookfield, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560037, India
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 89700 07818
- Email: xingtattoo.aecs@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday 10:00 AM – 9:00 PM · Tuesday Closed · Wednesday–Sunday 10:00 AM – 9:00 PM
- Google rating: 4.9★ · 200+ Google reviews
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps?cid=12620788765505602551
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=Xing+Premium+Tattoo+Studio+Brookefield+Bangalore
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/xingtattoo_blr/
- Lead Artist: Peace (Chingri Awungshi), 15+ years
- Areas served: Brookefield, AECS Layout, Marathahalli, Whitefield, East Bengaluru
- Amenities: Wheelchair-accessible seating · Free Wi-Fi · Gender-neutral restroom · LGBTQ+ friendly · Credit cards, Debit cards, Google Pay
